data.title: 神裂火织 · 客厅特制堕天使女仆装递茶
data.description: 公寓客厅的明媚阳光下，换上短款堕天使女仆装的神裂火织双手端着茶盘。平时威风凛凛的圣人满面绯红、眼角噙着娇羞泪水，双腿并拢结结巴巴地为你奉上红茶。
data.location: bright cozy modern living room with coffee table
data.action: standing holding a tea tray, wearing an embarrassing maid outfit, blushing furiously from ears to collarbones, stammering with shy violet eyes
data.lighting: soft bright daylight pouring through sheer living room curtains
data.mood: unbeatable legendary gap moe, adorable maid embarrassment, breathtaking mature charm
data.promptProse: Standing in a living room holding a tea tray in a maid dress, Kaori Kanzaki blushes crimson with shy violet eyes and trembling lips.
data.animaCaption: Kaori Kanzaki blushing crimson serving tea in fallen angel maid outfit.
